title: Kensington Universal Charge & Sync Tablet Cabinet
body_html:
Ten tablets, charged, synced, and locked down overnight.

This Kensington cabinet securely stores, charges, and syncs up to 10 tablets so a shared fleet is powered and ready each morning. Adjustable drawers fit devices in their cases, a tamper-resistant retracting door with keyed access keeps them safe, and a built-in cooling fan protects the hardware.

Key features

  • Stores, charges, and syncs up to 10 tablets at once
  • Stackable to manage up to 30 devices
  • Tamper-resistant retracting door with keyed lock
  • Built-in cooling fan prevents overheating
  • Universal fit — iPad, Galaxy Tab, Kindle and more, cases on

Who it’s for

Schools, training rooms, and shared-device environments that store, secure, and charge a tablet fleet overnight.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
